Name: RESULT_MENU_PLAY_SPEED_PARAM_ST
Description: Playback speed options of the result screen replay, listed in row order.

Fields.Name: Is Default Speed
Fields.Description: Set: this speed is selected when the replay speed menu opens. The first row with it set wins; with none, the speed starts at 1x. Retail: set on the 1x row.

Fields.Name: Playback Speed
Fields.Description: The playback speed of the result menu.

Fields.Name: Option Text ID
Fields.Description: The text to use for this option.
